title: The Fall of Hyperion
author: Dan Simmons
summary: The second half of the story begun in Hyperion. Pilgrims travel to a distant world to face a dreaded figure while a galactic war closes in, and the book explains much of what the first one left open.
readIf: you loved Hyperion and want the sweeping, idea-heavy answer to its mysteries.
skipIf: you have not read Hyperion, because this is a direct continuation and makes little sense alone.

pairings.reason: Another dense, philosophical science-fiction epic about power, religion and the future of humanity.
Shorter and more streetwise, but just as interested in artificial minds and what they want.
Equally ambitious about civilisations and cosmic threat, with a more scientific flavour.
